cells.rationale: FRED showed exactly 200,000 for the week ending 2026-11-07 (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/ICSA, 2026-11-12), after 191,000 the week before, and a 194K print on 2026-10-29 (https://investinglive.com/news/us-initial-jobless-claims-194k-vs-199k-expected/). Long-run base rates (85.6% above 200K since 2025) are high, but recent first prints cluster around 191-200K, so a strict 'above 200,000' needs a rise from a level near 195-200K and a tie of exactly 200,000 fails. The release is scheduled for 2026-11-19 (https://www.financecalendar.com/event/us-initial-jobless-claims-november-19-2026/); the 709,000 RTTNews figure was discarded as unreliable.

note: Recorded before every entry's cutoff; scored as a separate method.
